name: Witch’s Lewd Curse
source:
You play as an ordinary man who’s been cursed by the powerful Witch, Velina, forcing you to collect lewd energy in order to break free. To lift the soul-binding spell, you’ll explore diverse regions, build intimate bonds, and indulge in sensual encounters with an array of bewitching monster girls—all while trying to uncover Velina’s hidden motives.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3407700/]Steam[/url]]
